status: retained unfixed findings; deployment authorized; XML/ODS import mitigation enabled

package_origins.twig/twig: phpMyAdmin bundled Composer vendor tree / composer.lock; replaced from project lock
package_origins.apache2*: installed by upstream php:8.3-apache; now installed as Debian runtime packages on custom PHP 8.4 FPM
package_origins.openssl, libssl3t64, openssl-provider-le: Debian OS packages inherited through PHP base; stable/security updates applied
package_origins.linux-libc-dev: PHP compilation toolchain inherited from base; removed from final filesystem

risk_rationale.libxml2: Required by PHP XML/DOM. XML/ODS import plugin classes are removed from the image and autoloader; direct XML/ODS import submissions return HTTP 403 before application parsing. No fixed Debian 13 package exists. This mitigates those upload paths, not every libxml2 path; retain remaining findings and await a stable fix or tested backport.
risk_rationale.curl/libcurl4t64: Retained for PHP CURL / version checking and HTTP healthcheck. No fixed version. Use explicit HTTPS URLs and avoid untrusted outbound targets; connection reuse issue remains a risk.
risk_rationale.libx11-6/libx11-data: Required transitively by GD/libXpm. No X server socket is mounted and no DISPLAY is configured in inspected deployment. Malicious X server path not expected in ordinary phpMyAdmin requests; do not add X sockets or DISPLAY.
risk_rationale.ncurses: Terminfo/terminal parsing libraries retained through PHP readline and base tooling. No web terminal feature. Avoid attacker-supplied terminal databases/environment; no Debian fix.
risk_rationale.util-linux: Container OS utilities/libraries, not phpMyAdmin request code. Do not grant privileged mode, host mounts or SYS_ADMIN; no fixed Debian package.
risk_rationale.libacl1: Required through OS runtime libraries/tools. Local filesystem/symlink conditions; no fixed package. Retain trusted ownership of configuration and program files.
risk_rationale.systemd libraries: systemd-homed service is absent; only libraries are installed. Source-package findings do not establish execution of systemd-homed. No ignore applied.
risk_rationale.Perl: Apache management scripts require Perl. Tar archive processing vulnerability is not a phpMyAdmin import path (PHP handles imports). Do not run Perl archive tooling on untrusted files.
